concept.hr: Trošak pripada mjesecu uporabe, a ne mjesecu u kojem je plaćen
concept.en: An expense belongs to the month of use, not the month it is paid

summary.hr: Godina računa za IT: podrška plaćena unaprijed, kolokacija naplaćena unatrag, račun koji kasni. Novac i trošak se razilaze i susreću na kraju.
summary.en: A year of IT invoices: support paid in advance, colocation billed in arrears, a late invoice. Watch cash and expense part and meet again.

title.en: Year end: what must be accrued

concept.hr: Usluge korištene ove godine, a naplaćene iduće, trošak su ove godine
concept.en: Services used this year but invoiced next year are this year's expense
